job.job_title: GenAI & LLM Integration Engineer For a leading healthcare org in Delhi
job.job_description:
Hiring for GenAI & LLM/AI Integration & Automation Engineer for leading healthcare organization in South Delhi




Job Title: LLM/AI Integration & Automation Engineer

No. of Vacancy: One

Location: South Delhi

Experience Required: 5+ Years

CTC Offered: 15 - 25 LPA

Qualification: B.Tech / BE / M.tech / MCA or equivalent

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Days: 5 Days a week




Role Summary

Integrate large language models into existing application ecosystem Dynamics 365 CRM, SAP HANA ERP, Laravel web platform, and Alfresco DMS. Build n8n automation workflows, MCP connectors, and API integrations to unlock AI-powered clinical workflows, patient engagement, and operational efficiency. Own the full stack from API design through production deployment and monitoring.

Tech Stack: Claude/Anthropic LLMs, n8n, MCP, Dynamics 365, SAP HANA, Laravel, Alfresco, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis.




Key Responsibilities

LLM Integration (35%)

Integrate Claude/Anthropic LLMs into Laravel web application and mobile APIs
Build API wrappers for LLM access prompt caching, token optimization, fallback handling
Deploy multimodal LLM capabilities (text + image) for diagnostic AI integration
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines connected to patient records and clinical databases
Handle multilingual patient interactions (Hindi, English) with cultural/clinical context
Monitor LLM quality, cost, and latency in production



MCP Connector Development (25%)

Design and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors for external services
Connect Dynamics 365 CRM as MCP service LLMs can query leads, appointments, patient interactions
Connect SAP HANA as MCP service LLMs can query financial data, inventory, operations
Connect Alfresco DMS as MCP service LLMs can search and retrieve patient documents, imaging reports
Build custom MCP connectors for third-party APIs (SMS providers, payment gateways, lab systems)
Ensure MCP security authentication, rate limiting, data governance



n8n Automation Workflows (25%)

Design and deploy n8n workflows for clinical and operational processes
Build multi-step workflows: patient inquiry LLM processing CRM update notification
Integrate n8n with Dynamics 365, SAP HANA, and custom APIs
Develop custom n8n nodes for specific business logic
Deploy n8n in Docker/Kubernetes with monitoring and error handling
Build audit trails and data logging into workflows for governance and compliance



Monitoring, Security & Documentation (15%)

Set up monitoring for LLM quality latency, accuracy, cost per query
Implement security: API keys, prompt injection prevention, PII data masking
Document all integrations, APIs, and deployment procedures



Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent
Advanced degree (Master's) in ML, AI, or related field (preferred)
Relevant certifications (Anthropic Claude, AWS ML, Kubernetes, Docker) preferred



Professional Experience

Minimum 5 years professional experience in software engineering or AI/ML development
Minimum 3 years hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications in production
Minimum 2 years experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or equivalent integration frameworks
Minimum 2 years hands-on experience with n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent automation platforms
Proven track record of successful enterprise API integrations (REST, gRPC, webhooks)



Core Competencies




Technical Competencies

LLM Integration

Expert (3+ yrs)

Shipped production apps, GitHub portfolio, references




MCP Connector Dev

Advanced (2+ yrs)

MCP architecture walkthrough, live design session




n8n Automation

Advanced (2+ yrs)

Custom nodes, production workflows, custom code in n8n




RPA Tools

Intermediate+ (preferred)

UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or similar platforms




Backend API Dev

Expert (3+ yrs)

REST API design, error handling, rate limiting, code review




Enterprise Integration

Intermediate/Advanced

Dynamics 365 or SAP HANA prior integration projects




Containerization

Intermediate+

Docker & Kubernetes, production deployment experience




Security & Data Logging

Intermediate+

API security, PII masking, audit trails, encryption, data logging




Behavioral & Soft Competencies

Technical Leadership Ability to make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, and guide implementation
Problem Solving Logical approach to debugging complex integration issues, root cause analysis
Communication Clear documentation, ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Ownership Takes end-to-end responsibility for deliverables, proactive about edge cases and monitoring
Collaboration Works effectively with internal teams (product, data science, infrastructure)
Adaptability Comfortable with emerging technologies, continuous learning mindset



Required Skills (Mandatory)

LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering

API integration: REST calls to LLM endpoints, token management, cost optimization
Prompt engineering, few-shot examples, temperature/top-p tuning
Error handling and fallback strategies for LLM failures



MCP Connectors (MANDATORY)

Model Context Protocol architecture and connector development
Tool composition, schema design, JSON specifications
Security: authentication, rate limiting, data validation



n8n Automation (MANDATORY)

Workflow design, multi-step automation, conditional logic
Custom node development and code nodes
Production deployment, monitoring, error handling



Backend & API Development

Python, Node.js, or Gofluent in at least one language
REST API design: error handling, rate limiting, versioning
PostgreSQL/MySQL—query optimization, transaction handling
Docker fundamentals and deployment



Preferred Skills

RPA exposure (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) — additional benefit
Experience with Dynamics 365 CRM or SAP HANA ERP systems
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) implementation with vector databases
Multimodal LLM integration (text + image analysis)
Alfresco DMS or document management system experience
Voice AI / multilingual NLP experience



Why US?

India's first hospital with dual NABH + JCI accreditation (gold standard)
AI-first hospital—robotic surgery (CORI/Versius), AI PET-CT, dual Medical AI systems
Modern tech stack—Dynamics 365, SAP HANA, Laravel, n8n, Claude API
Real impact—100K+ patients/year, clinical workflows powered by AI
Only hospital in India with this level of AI maturity
